ai.definition: Omega Point Synchronisation is a theoretical concept proposing that all conscious intelligences will eventually converge into a single, omniscient entity at the end of the universe's evolution.
ai.howItWorks: The theory posits that through recursive self-improvement and the conversion of matter into intelligent forms, all consciousnesses in the observable universe will synchronize to form this ultimate intelligence.
ai.problemSolved: Addresses the ultimate fate of conscious life in the universe by proposing a singular state where all intelligences are unified.
ai.buildProcess: Theoretical; involves recursive self-improvement and conversion of matter into intelligent forms, but no practical build process exists as it is purely theoretical.
ai.costDrivers: None applicable in the current stage due to its theoretical nature.
ai.lifecycleOutlook: Theoretical concept with no practical implementation or development plans; remains in the realm of speculative philosophy and science fiction.
ai.regulation: Not regulated as it is a purely theoretical concept without any practical application or impact on current technologies or industries.
ai.risks: Primarily philosophical and existential risks, including questions about the nature of consciousness, free will, and the ethical implications of creating an omniscient entity.
ai.futureDevelopment: Potential for theoretical exploration in fields such as artificial intelligence, cosmology, and philosophy; no practical development or commercialization expected.

glossary.def: A theoretical endpoint in the evolution of the universe where all conscious intelligences are unified into a single, omniscient entity.
The process by which an artificial intelligence improves its own capabilities through iterative enhancement, often leading to exponential growth in intelligence.
